$why: Pressless's release recipe (cut-release). pyproject.toml holds the only version line: scripts/freeze_flags.py and the release workflow's tag check both read it from there (PRESS-0022 section 4.4). src/pressless/__init__.py carries __version__ too, because pyproject.toml is not in the bundle and the Updater compares against it (PRESS-0023 INV-17); tests/test_version.py fails when the two differ.
todos: Close [Unreleased] into [{NEW}] - {TODAY}: changelog_log op:"release" version:"{NEW}" date:"{TODAY}"

Refresh the release lock when a dependency or a floor changed, or the release should take newer libraries: uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra dev --extra packaging --universal --python-version 3.13 --generate-hashes --no-header -o packaging/release-requirements.txt (PRESS-0022 section 4.4). Commit it before tagging; the release jobs install nothing else from pip.

Run the by-hand checks no gate can run, and say in the report which were run: Edge and Chrome on the Windows box, the console window there, the real keyring prompt in the logged-on desktop session, and a real publish through the Publish button. Owed before every release, which is why it is here and not under a milestone. PRESS-0133 holds the detail and what is still outstanding.

After the tag is pushed, the release workflow has built the draft, and the by-hand checks above have passed: python3 scripts/sign-release.py v{NEW}. It signs the draft and PUBLISHES it, so it is the last step. A session may run it (user decision 2026-09-29): the script reads the key file and never prints it.
post_check: v=$(python3 scripts/freeze_flags.py version) && grep -qx "__version__ = \"$v\"" src/pressless/__init__.py && grep -Eq "^## \\[$v\\] - [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\$" CHANGELOG.md
